name: Aaron Simons
notable_stories: Worked in the logging industry and later as a farmer in Delta Township, Washington
C-005: 1900 Census (Michigan): Aaron Simons, age 48, birthplace Ohio. Confirms Ohio origin.
1910 Census (Washington): Aaron Simons, age 58. Household also includes 'Zell Busey, age 4 (unknown)' — unidentified person in the household.
1920 Census (Washington): Aaron Simons, age 68 (farmer). Hattie age 62.
Simons, McPhail, and Kulp families were located within a few farms of each other. Raymond Simons and Dradie Kulp were neighbors prior to marriage.
milestones: Migration path: Ohio to Michigan (by 1900) to Whatcom County, Washington (by 1910)
1900: living in Michigan; 1910: living in Washington; 1920: living in Washington (farmer)
career: Aaron Simons worked in logging in 1910.
Aaron Simons was a general farmer in 1920.
locations: Burk Road, Delta Township, Whatcom County, Washington
